    Bug 1983827 - Add glean probe for tracking fluent ID error counts in account hub. r=vineet
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D275976

diff --git a/mail/components/accountcreation/content/widgets/account-hub-header.mjs b/mail/components/accountcreation/content/widgets/account-hub-header.mjs
index 41bb6aaaa2d..ab0b3f1de9c 100644
--- a/mail/components/accountcreation/content/widgets/account-hub-header.mjs
+++ b/mail/components/accountcreation/content/widgets/account-hub-header.mjs
@@ -108,6 +108,9 @@ class AccountHubHeader extends HTMLElement {
         `Account setup error: ${error?.cause?.title || error?.message}. ${error?.cause?.text}`,
         error
       );
+      if (fluentTitleId) {
+        Glean.mail.accountHubError[fluentTitleId].add(1);
+      }
     }
 
     // Hide the notification bar.
diff --git a/mail/metrics.yaml b/mail/metrics.yaml
index 7732ba4afbf..84e7c8e209b 100644
--- a/mail/metrics.yaml
+++ b/mail/metrics.yaml
@@ -660,3 +660,17 @@ mail:
       view_name:
         description: Name of the view or subview.
         type: string
+
+  account_hub_error:
+    type: labeled_counter
+    description:
+      Tracks account hub error counts, keyed by data-l10n-id.
+    bugs:
+      - https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1983827
+    data_reviews:
+      - https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1983827#c3
+    data_sensitivity:
+      - technical
+    notification_emails:
+      - telemetry-client-dev@thunderbird.net
+    expires: never

@@ -591,6 +591,7 @@ add_task(async function test_remoteAddressBookRememberPassword() {
 });
 
 add_task(async function test_unsupportedCardDAVServer() {
+  Services.fog.testResetFOG();
   const login = await createLogin("https://bad.invalid");
 
   const dialog = await subtest_open_account_hub_dialog("ADDRESS_BOOK");
@@ -608,6 +609,13 @@ add_task(async function test_unsupportedCardDAVServer() {
   Services.logins.removeLogin(login);
   CardDAVServer.resetHandlers();
   await dialog.querySelector("account-hub-address-book").reset();
+  Assert.equal(
+    Glean.mail.accountHubError[

+    ].testGetValue(),

+    "should have recorded one incompatibility error"
+  );
 });
